text: SCH3858's activity has triggered a detection rule due to an unusual number of visits to job-search sites, with 45 visits exceeding their recent typical range by more than three standard deviations. This is particularly noteworthy given that same-role peers only recorded one visit to such sites this week. While SCH3858's overall browsing habits seem normal, with no anomalous activity on leak-publication or cloud-storage sites, and a typical number of distinct web domains visited and workstations used, the spike in job-search site visits warrants further investigation.
